questions.question: Visible and invisible items of debit and credit are the part of___________.
questions.solution:
Visible and invisible items of debit and credit are the part of the balance of payment.

The balance of Payment is a full record of a financial transaction between residents and residents of the rest of the world in a specific year.

It includes current account and capital account.

Current account further includes visible trade, invisible trade, income receipts, and Unilateral transfers to and from abroad.

Capital account includes Investments to/from abroad, Loans to and borrowings from abroad, and Changes in foreign exchange reserves.

Visible items refer to import and export of goods.

Invisible items refer to import and export of services.

questions.question: Who of the following operated the first regular trade union in India?
questions.solution:
B.P. Wadia operated the first regular trade union in India.

Bahman Pestonji Wadia (1881-1958) was an Indian theosophist and labor activist.

Founded by B.P. Wadia in 1918, the Madras Labour Union is considered to be the first registered trade union in India.

questions.question: How much longitude does the Earth move in an hour?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**15°**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

The Earth moves 15° in an hour.

In 24hrs, the Earth completes one rotation of 360° along its axis.

In 1hr = 360/24 = 15°

questions.question: What is the position of metallic ion and non-metallic ion in a chemical formula?

options.text: Metal ion at the second position
Metal ion at first and non-metal ion at the second position

questions.solution:
In a chemical formula, the Metal ion is at first and non-metal ion at the second position

Metals tend to form a cation, while non-metals tend to form anions.

When a metal reacts with a nonmetal (or a polyatomic ion), usually Ionic compounds are formed.

While writing the formula of ionic compounds, the cation is written first, followed by the anion.

For example- Na⁺Cl⁻, MgO, CaBr₂, etc.

questions.question: In which of the following part of Neuron the information is transmitted in the chemical form?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**No option is correct**__.

__
 
• At **synapses **of the Neuron, the information is transmitted in the chemical form, called as **Neurotransmitter**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• Synapse:

 
 
• It is the junction between 2 neurons.
 
• There is a very narrow gap of about 20nm between neurons called the synaptic cleft.
 
• An action potential cannot cross the synaptic cleft, so nerve impulses are carried by chemicals called neurotransmitters.
 
 
 
• The structure of a synapse:
 
 
• At the synapse, the presynaptic neuron communicates with the postsynaptic neuron.
 
• At the end of the presynaptic neuron, there are synaptic knobs.
 
• Synaptic knobs contain many mitochondria and large amounts of ER to manufacture neurotransmitters.
 
• There is a tiny gap known as the synaptic cleft
 
 
 
• Functions of a synapse:
 
 
• A single impulse is transmitted to a number of different neurons creating simultaneous responses.
 
• A number of impulses are combined at a synapse allowing stimuli from different receptors to interact for a single response.

questions.question: To commemorate the 75th anniversary of Quit India Movement, which program was organized by the Central Government in August 2017?
questions.solution:
Sankalp se Siddhi was organized by the Central Government in August 2017 to commemorate the 75th anniversary of Quit India Movement.

Quit India Movement was launched by Mahatma Gandhi on 8th August 1942, demanding to end the British Raj from India.

PM Modi described this month as the month of revolution as on August 1, 1920 non-cooperation movement was launched, on August 8, 1942, and finally on August 15, 1947, India finally got independence.

Through Sankalp se Siddhi, PM Modi calls on people to take a pledge to make India free from poverty, corruption, discrimination, terrorism, etc.

questions.question: On 19 September 2017, Law Ministry approved Fugitive Economic Offenders Bill, 2017. It will empower the government to _______ property of economic offenders and defaulters who flee from India.
questions.solution:
On 19 September 2017, Law Ministry approved Fugitive Economic Offenders Bill, 2017. It will empower the government to confiscate the property of economic offenders and defaulters who flee from India.

The Bill will be applicable to cases where the value of offence is more than 100 crore.

The Bill will further allow Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) to declare the person as the fugitive economic offender and then file an application against him to confiscate their assets.

questions.question: Quantitatively, the inertia of an object is measured by __________

options.text: the product of its mass and velocity
the product of its mass and acceleration

questions.solution:
Quantitatively, the inertia of an object is measured by __**its mass**__.

__**EXPLANATION:**__

According to Newton’s First Law of Motion-

 
• "An object at rest stays at rest and an object in motion stays in motion with the same speed and in the same direction unless acted upon by an unbalanced force."
 
• This tendency of objects to resist change in their state of motion is referred to as inertia.
 
• This tendency depends on the mass of the object; the more massive an object is, the more it’ll have a tendency to resist change in its state of motion.

questions.question: An instrument that measures the wind speed is called ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__An anemometer__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Anemometer: It is an instrument used to measure the speed of the wind, which is a common weather station instrument, or to calculate any form of current gas.

 
 
• The term is derived from the Greek word anemos meaning wind which was first explained by Leon Battista Alberti who was an Italian artist and architect in the year 1450.
 
• He used a mechanical anemometer which was placed perpendicular to the wind direction such that the wind velocity as indicated by the angle of inclination of the disc.
 
 
 
• Types of anemometer:
 
 
• Cup anemometer: This consists of four hemispherical cups that are mounted on one end of the horizontal arms at equal angles on a vertical shaft. 
 
• Hotwire anemometer: This consists of thin wire which is heated up to a certain temperature slightly more than atmospheric temperature. 
 
• Windmill anemometer: This is a mechanical device similar to the regular windmill used to calculate the velocity of the wind. It consists of the axis of rotation running parallel to the direction of the wind. 
 
• Laser Doppler anemometer: A beam of light is used which is further split into two beams. The velocity is determined by calculating the amount of light that has been reflected.
 
• Sonic anemometer: Sound waves from this anemometer are used to obtain the speed of the wind. These waves are made to pass through the transducer. These find applications in aircraft and scientific wind turbines.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Manometers **are devices in which columns of a suitable liquid are used to measure the difference in pressure between two points or between a certain point and the atmosphere.
 
• An odometer is a device that is used for measuring the distance traveled by a vehicle.
 
• A barometer is a scientific instrument used to measure atmospheric pressure, also called barometric pressure.

questions.question:
Which of the statements given below are correct?

A) Belgium hosted the Table Tennis 2017 ITTF Men's World Cup.

B) In 2017, Giannis Antetokounmpo played for the NBA team, Milwaukee Bucks.

C) The United Arab Emirates hosted the 2017 Indoor Cricket World Cup.
questions.solution:
All the options are correct.

The Table Tennis 2017 ITTF Men's World Cup was held in Liège, Belgium, from 20-22 October 2017 in which Germany's Dimitrij Ovtcharov won his first World Cup.

Giannis Antetokounmpo is a Greek professional basketball player, who has been playing for Milwaukee Bucks since 2013. In 2017, Giannis Antetokounmpo played for the NBA team,Milwaukee Bucks. The Bucks, however, were eliminated from the playoffs.

The United Arab Emirates hosted the 2017 Indoor Cricket World Cup, where Australia won the title in both men and women division.
